item.title: Why Your Organization Needs Agent Infrastructure, Not More Agents
item.author: David Twizer
item.description: The gap between “we have 5 agents” and “we have 500 agents” is not filled by buying more products. It is filled by building the foundation.

item.title: We're Not the Only Ones Building Agent Infrastructure. Here's the Difference.
item.author: David Twizer
item.description: An external vertical agent is not an internal agent. A platform that wraps your code and takes over the runtime is not really infrastructure.
